autosaddler-appendix.title: AutoSaddler agent-side reconstruction
implemented: Communication, ambiguity, ordering, email, path, and monitoring guidance.
limitations: No final author snapshot. No new or modified environment tools. No automatic inter-turn polling or filesystem resolver. Email hook represented as policy, not an identical executor hook.

activesaddler-appendix.title: ActiveSaddler case-study reconstruction
implemented: Multiline literal-signature guard and pre-creation calendar ambiguity guard, with case-study guidance.
limitations: Only two published repair cases. Guard recognizers cover explicit literal signatures and native public calendar receipts; no hidden task IDs. Full evolved harness and broad semantic trigger logic are unavailable.

paretosaddler-i23-appendix.title: ParetoSaddler I-23 agent-side reconstruction
implemented: Reconstructed agent instructions for target resolution, ordering, monitoring, and completion.
limitations: No frozen I-23 source. Tool extensions, exact pre-tool guards, and termination-code changes are not reconstructed. These are policy-level counterparts.

paretosaddler-i22-appendix.title: ParetoSaddler I-22 agent-side reconstruction
implemented: Compact-query and reminder policies; conservative terminal-text to native user-interface action conversion.
limitations: No frozen I-22 source. Environment tool extensions are not present. Terminal conversion is restricted to explicit Final answer text after tool activity. The unimplemented research monitoring tool is not fabricated.

harnessmm-public-continuation.title: HarnessMM public deterministic continuation
implemented: Published PublicContinuation controller and plan instruction; non-stall mode, maximum three follow-ups. Native engine adapter with checkpointable state.
limitations: Historical public component, not the frozen 480-task agent. No one-token selector, typed later bank, context-v16, or combined-paper-score claim.
